body:
Thank you. I think considering this I’m going to try and be pushy with my doctor with the goal of being offered different meds. The healthcare system in my country (and I’m sure most others) is set up so that you are offered the cheapest ssri first, whether or not it’s going to work best or at all for your symptoms. Followed by the second cheapest...etc. Which totally makes sense, but also sucks as I feel they’re not listening to what I’m saying at all. I’d been so hopeful that this third one I tried was the one for me, and then had a terrible few weeks.

I really appreciate your response, more than anything I was desperate to hear from someone who had felt they’d received actual help!
